definitions.explanation: Sustaining a physical injury, especially in accidents, disasters, conflicts, or sports. A formal term used in news reports and official communications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{負傷|ふしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Three people were injured in the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{試合中|しあいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{負傷|ふしょう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{退場|たいじょう}→退場：14353_taijou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The player was injured during the match and left the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{負傷|ふしょう}し、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many residents were injured in the earthquake and were transported to hospitals.

notes:
USAGE:
{負傷|ふしょう} is a formal term used primarily in news, military, and official contexts. The everyday equivalent is {怪我|けが}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧ (injured person, casualty)
- ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to sustain a serious injury)
- {負傷|ふしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to sustain an injury)
- {負傷兵|ふしょうへい} (wounded soldier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {負傷|ふしょう}: injury (formal, news/military)
- {怪我|けが}: injury (everyday, general)
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: wound, injury (the wound itself)
- ⟦{外傷|がいしょう}→外傷：12148_gaishou⟧: trauma, external injury (medical)
